Ordering large groups of systems with is convenient, but it can be overly strict. If system set is chained before system set , every system in must finish before system in can start, even when the systems involved never touch the same data. This often leaves worker threads idle while they wait for a handful of stragglers at the end of a system set, a pattern that shows up frequently in the render world.

.chain()

X

Y

X

any

Y

The new , , and functions provide a looser alternative. Like their regular counterparts, they request an ordering between successive elements, however that ordering is only kept between systems whose data accesses actually conflict. Systems that don't conflict are left unordered and may run in any order, including in parallel.

chain_weak()

before_weak()

after_weak()

schedule.configure_sets( ( ExtractCommands, PrepareMeshes, CreateViews, Specialize, PrepareViews, Queue, PhaseSort, Prepare, Render, Cleanup, PostCleanup, ) .chain_weak(),);

When two weakly-ordered systems actually conflict on their data access, a normal ordering is kept between them, so the earlier one still runs first. Two systems that conflict only through a non-conflicting system between them in the chain stay ordered as well. Non-conflicting systems, however, are left free to run in any order and overlap for increased parallelism!

Two kinds of system are treated as always conflicting, so their ordering is always kept: an earlier system that produces deferred effects such as (so the later system observes them, with an sync point inserted as usual), and exclusive systems (which cannot overlap anything regardless).

Commands

ApplyDeferred

Because the scheduler can only see accesses it tracks, dependencies expressed through interior mutability on read-only accesses, global state, or other untracked methods are respected. Use only when your systems don't rely on such hidden ordering, otherwise stick with .not

item.description:
一句话：特性冻结后的整体盘点：原生拖尾、模糊搜索，以及一份要提前看的破坏性变更清单。

要点：

  • 4.8 已进入特性冻结，开发资源全部转向回归修复，因此相对 dev 7 没有新特性，本文是整体盘点
  • 新增原生 Trail3D：做拖尾类特效不再需要自己处理网格绘制与 UV 分配
  • 核心侧引入 FuzzySearch 模糊搜索、3D 视口按轴覆盖等编辑器改进，并逐项列出破坏性变更（ScriptServer、ClassDB、PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE、SCREEN_UV 等）

为什么值得看：升级前先对一遍破坏性变更清单，尤其是脚本服务器与属性存储相关项，比读功能列表更重要。

中文摘要：Godot 4.8 进入 beta 1，意味着特性已完全冻结，开发者资源转向回归修复与缺陷排查，因此这一篇不再是新特性清单，而是对整个 4.8 的盘点与补充说明。渲染与 3D 侧最实用的新增是原生 Trail3D：想做拖尾特效不必再深入网格绘制、UV 分配这些细节。编辑器与核心侧有「允许视口覆盖」的 3D 视口轴向切换、以及面向版本控制的更整洁的对象序列化，此外 FuzzySearch 模糊搜索正式对所有用户开放。文章也逐项列出破坏性变更，涉及 ScriptServer、ClassDB、PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE、OS.alert()、SCREEN_UV 等，并给出对应的 PR 编号，方便升级前逐条核对。

一句话：特性冻结后的整体盘点：原生拖尾、模糊搜索，以及一份要提前看的破坏性变更清单。

要点：

  • 4.8 已进入特性冻结，开发资源全部转向回归修复，因此相对 dev 7 没有新特性，本文是整体盘点
  • 新增原生 Trail3D：做拖尾类特效不再需要自己处理网格绘制与 UV 分配
  • 核心侧引入 FuzzySearch 模糊搜索、3D 视口按轴覆盖等编辑器改进，并逐项列出破坏性变更（ScriptServer、ClassDB、PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE、SCREEN_UV 等）

为什么值得看：升级前先对一遍破坏性变更清单，尤其是脚本服务器与属性存储相关项，比读功能列表更重要。

中文摘要：Godot 4.8 进入 beta 1，意味着特性已完全冻结，开发者资源转向回归修复与缺陷排查，因此这一篇不再是新特性清单，而是对整个 4.8 的盘点与补充说明。渲染与 3D 侧最实用的新增是原生 Trail3D：想做拖尾特效不必再深入网格绘制、UV 分配这些细节。编辑器与核心侧有「允许视口覆盖」的 3D 视口轴向切换、以及面向版本控制的更整洁的对象序列化，此外 FuzzySearch 模糊搜索正式对所有用户开放。文章也逐项列出破坏性变更，涉及 ScriptServer、ClassDB、PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE、OS.alert()、SCREEN_UV 等，并给出对应的 PR 编号，方便升级前逐条核对。

主题：游戏引擎

来源：Godot（English）

RitaA game by SporkTank

Dev snapshot: Godot 4.8 beta 1

By:

Pre-release

It’s that time of the release cycle once again: the beta snapshot! With this, 4.8 is fully in feature-freeze, and developer resources have shifted exclusively to creating and reviewing various .

regression fixes

For those interested in aiding us on our quest to squash any bugs that come up during this time, we once again encourage you to join our bug-hunting sprints. Anyone interested should read the for more information, and join the and channels on our developer RocketChat to participate.

#bugsquad

#bugsquad-sprints

supporting the project financially

, and give it a spin right now, or continue reading to learn more about improvements in this release. You can also try the , the , or the for this release. If you are interested in the latter, please request to join to get access to pre-release builds.

our testing group
